sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简讯栏目

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《Dealbook》的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市Dealbook峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域一些举足轻重的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费阅读我们所有的新闻报道一个月。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你会收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today,
sentences.zh: 今天，

sentences.en: President Trump is now saying that Iran appears to be responsible for the weekend attacks on Saudi
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统现在表示，伊朗似乎对周末袭击沙特

sentences.en: Arabia's oil facilities.
sentences.zh: 阿拉伯石油设施的事件负有责任。

sentences.en: David Sanger on where things are likely to go from here.
sentences.zh: 大卫·桑格将为我们分析事态接下来的可能走向。

sentences.en: Tuesday,
sentences.zh: 星期二，

sentences.en: September 17th.
David, describe the scene in Saudi Arabia on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 大卫，请描述一下周六沙特阿拉伯的现场情况。

sentences.en: Well, Michael, we're all still trying to piece it together.
sentences.zh: 好的，迈克尔，我们大家仍在努力拼凑事情的真相。

sentences.en: But what we do know is that at about 3.30 in the morning on Saturday morning in Saudi Arabia, there were a series of explosions at a number of refinery facilities.
sentences.zh: 但我们所知道的是，在沙特阿拉伯周六早晨大约3点30分，多个炼油设施发生了一系列爆炸。

sentences.en: And of course, it was, you know, dark.
sentences.zh: 当然，当时天是黑的。

sentences.en: No one exactly knew what was happening, other than the fires were burning.
sentences.zh: 除了烈火熊熊，没人确切知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: It wasn't clear where these came from, and it wasn't until the sun rose, that they saw a really remarkably extensive amount of damage.
sentences.zh: 这些袭击源自何处并不明朗，直到太阳升起，人们才看到极其惊人的广泛破坏。

sentences.en: And what they discovered was that a number of their big oil fields were burning.
sentences.zh: 他们发现他们的一些大型油田正在燃烧。

sentences.en: And when you look at the satellite photographs, you see classic oil field kind of operations.
sentences.zh: 当你查看卫星照片时，你会看到典型的油田那种作业设施。

sentences.en: Big tanks, lots of pipes, and obviously lots of facilities that if hit by a weapon can burn.
sentences.zh: 大油罐、大量的管道，显然还有许多一旦被武器击中就会燃烧的设施。

sentences.en: And that's exactly what happened.
sentences.zh: 而这正是发生的事情。

sentences.en: This was bigger than anything we had ever seen done to oil fields in Saudi Arabia at any time in history.
sentences.zh: 这是沙特阿拉伯油田有史以来遭受过的规模最大的袭击。

sentences.en: And David, help us understand the significance of hitting oil fields in Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 大卫，请帮我们理解袭击沙特油田的重大意义。

sentences.en: What's the impact of that?
sentences.zh: 这会带来什么影响？

sentences.en: Well, Saudi Arabia obviously is among the world's biggest oil producers.
sentences.zh: 很显然，沙特阿拉伯是世界最大的产油国之一。

sentences.en: These facilities account,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，这些设施占了

sentences.en: Michael, for about 6% of the oil that's pumped around the world every day.
sentences.zh: 全球每天开采的石油总量的约6%。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: The Saudis themselves produce roughly 10 million barrels a day.
sentences.zh: 沙特人自己每天生产大约1000万桶石油。

sentences.en: These facilities are capable of doing somewhere between 5 and 8 million of that.
sentences.zh: 这些设施的产能大约占其中的500万到800万桶。

sentences.en: So this is a significant amount for world production, but it's a huge amount for the Saudi production.
sentences.zh: 因此，这对全球产量来说是一个可观的数字，但对于沙特产量而言却是一个巨大的数字。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So if someone is interested in striking Saudi Arabia and striking the global economy, this is a very good target.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果有人有兴趣打击沙特阿拉伯并冲击全球经济，这是一个极佳的目标。

sentences.en: It's the best target you could find.
sentences.zh: 这是你能找到的最好的目标。

sentences.en: And what is the original understanding of what has happened and who did it?
sentences.zh: 那么对于发生了什么以及是谁干的，最初的了解是什么？

sentences.en: Well, before there was understanding, there was a claim of responsibility.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在了解情况之前，先有人声称对此负责。

sentences.en: The Houthis, who are engaged in a pretty desperate war with the Saudis in Yemen, immediately claim credit for this.
sentences.zh: 正在也门与沙特进行一场绝望战争的胡塞武装立即宣称对此负责。

sentences.en: We promised the Saudi regime that our coming operations will only grow wider and will be more painful than before, so long as their aggression and blockade continues.
sentences.zh: 我们向沙特政权保证，只要他们的侵略和封锁继续下去，我们接下来的行动只会规模更大、比以往更加痛苦。

sentences.en: They said that they sent 10 drones into Saudi Arabia and that those were responsible for the hit.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，他们向沙特阿拉伯派出了10架无人机，并由这些无人机负责这次袭击。

sentences.en: So as the initial reports came out on Saturday...
sentences.zh: 因此，当周六最初的报道出来时……

sentences.en: The Houthi movement from neighboring Yemen has taken credit for the attacks.
sentences.zh: 来自邻国也门的胡塞武装认领了这些袭击。

sentences.en: The Saudi government has been backing the Yemeni government's fight against some rebels.
sentences.zh: 沙特政府一直支持也门政府打击某些叛军。

sentences.en: That seemed a perfectly credible explanation, until you dug into the facts a little more.
sentences.zh: 这听起来是一个完全可信的解释，直到你稍微深入挖掘事实。

sentences.en: Then a few things just didn't add up.
sentences.zh: 然后有些事情就对不上了。

sentences.en: The first thing is that Secretary of State Mike Pompeo turned out a statement on Saturday evening East Coast time.
sentences.zh: 第一件事是，美国东部时间周六晚上，国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥发表了一份声明。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, America's top diplomat putting the blame squarely on Iran.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，美国的最高外交官将矛头直指伊朗。

sentences.en: The Secretary of State Mike Pompeo tweeting this, quote,
sentences.zh: 国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥发推文称，引述：

sentences.en: Tehran is behind nearly 100 attacks on Saudi Arabia...
sentences.zh: 德黑兰是针对沙特阿拉伯近100起袭击的幕后黑手……

sentences.en: Charging that the Iranians had been responsible for this.
sentences.zh: 指控伊朗人对此负责。

sentences.en: Iran has now launched an unprecedented attack on the world's energy supply.
sentences.zh: 伊朗现在对世界的能源供应发动了一次前所未有的袭击。

sentences.en: He did not provide evidence, but he said this didn't come from the Houthis, it didn't come from Yemen, and it was an Iranian operation.
sentences.zh: 他没有提供证据，但他表示这不是来自胡塞武装，不是来自也门，这是一次伊朗的行动。

sentences.en: One might be a little bit skeptical of that, but then we saw that there were 17 different strike points, and that became evident from some satellite photographs.
sentences.zh: 人们可能会对此产生一些怀疑，但随后我们看到有17个不同的打击点，这从一些卫星照片中变得显而易见。

sentences.en: Those satellite photographs showed 17 separate strikes that didn't quite seem to add up with 10 drones.
sentences.zh: 这些卫星照片显示了17处独立的打击，这与10架无人机似乎不太相符。

sentences.en: The second thing is that these strikes were deep inside Saudi Arabia, and it would have required a flight of 500 miles or so for drones to be able to get there,
sentences.zh: 第二件事是，这些袭击发生在沙特阿拉伯腹地，无人机需要飞行大约500英里才能到达那里，

sentences.en: and that seems well beyond the range of what we've seen the Houthis be able to do before.
sentences.zh: 这似乎远远超出了我们以前所见胡塞武装能够做到的范围。

sentences.en: And then as we looked more and more at these satellite photographs, it seemed clear that these were precision strikes.
sentences.zh: 随着我们对这些卫星照片进行越来越多的观察，很明显这些是精确打击。

sentences.en: In fact, there was a hole in the domes of some of the storage facilities that were each in precisely the same place,
sentences.zh: 事实上，一些储油设施圆顶上都有一个洞，每个洞的位置都完全精确，

sentences.en: and they were neatly bored little holes that seemed to suggest a missile strike, not a drone that just was carrying some explosives.
sentences.zh: 而且它们是整齐钻出的小洞，这似乎暗示是导弹袭击，而不是只携带了一些炸药的无人机。

sentences.en: So the initial story just didn't seem to match with what we were looking at in the photographs.
sentences.zh: 因此，最初的说法似乎与我们在照片中看到的不符。

sentences.en: And then what happens?
sentences.zh: 然后发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, then the president took to Twitter, and he said on Sunday that, well, I'll read it to you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，然后总统发了推特，他在周日说，好吧，我读给你听。

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia oil supply was attacked.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯的石油供应遭到袭击。

sentences.en: There's reason to believe we know the culprit, are locked and loaded depending on verification, but are waiting to hear from the kingdom
sentences.zh: 有理由相信我们知道罪魁祸首，我们已箭在弦上蓄势待发，具体取决于核实情况，但正在等待该王国表态

sentences.en: as to who they believe was the cause of this attack, and under what terms we would proceed.
sentences.zh: 关于他们认为谁是这次袭击的始作俑者，以及我们将在什么条件下采取行动。

sentences.en: Kingdom is a reference to the kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 王国指的是沙特阿拉伯王国。

sentences.en: The kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯王国。

sentences.en: So here we have the president of the United States in charge of the world's largest and most powerful intelligence and military forces saying that he is waiting for the Saudis
sentences.zh: 所以在这里，掌控着世界上最大、最强大的情报和军事力量的美国总统表示，他正在等待沙特人

sentences.en: to tell him who they believe triggered this attack and to tell him what terms they would proceed on.
sentences.zh: 告诉他他们认为是谁触发了这次袭击，并告诉他他们将在什么条件下继续行动。

sentences.en: Well, it sounds like they're discussing some kind of joint response, but the United States for the past 200 plus years decides on its own
sentences.zh: 听起来他们是在讨论某种联合回应，但在过去200多年的时间里，美国都是自己决定

sentences.en: whether or not it is going to come to the defense of an ally, conduct a military strike, or any other kind of response.
sentences.zh: 是否要保卫盟友、进行军事打击或做出任何其他形式的回应。

sentences.en: It's somewhat remarkable to hear that they're waiting for instructions from an ally, which is what the president's tweet sounded like he was saying.
sentences.zh: 听到他们正在等待来自盟友的指示，这有点引人注目，这听起来正是总统推文的意思。

sentences.en: And David, it's not just an ally, right?
sentences.zh: 大卫，这不仅仅是一个盟友，对吧？

sentences.en: It's Saudi Arabia, and we're coming up on the one-year anniversary of Jamal Khashoggi's death, which there's a significant amount of evidence
sentences.zh: 这是沙特阿拉伯，而且我们即将迎来贾迈勒·卡舒吉遇害一周年，有大量证据表明

sentences.en: that Mohammed bin Salman, the leader of Saudi Arabia, ordered.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯领导人穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼下令实施了这起谋杀。

sentences.en: So it also seems somewhat extraordinary for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 鉴于这一历史记录，美国

sentences.en: to defer to Saudi Arabia given that track record.
sentences.zh: 顺从沙特阿拉伯也显得有些不同寻常。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The administration had been under tremendous pressure after the murder to identify MBS, as he's called, as somebody who was involved.
sentences.zh: 谋杀发生后，政府承受了巨大的压力，要求认定这位被称为MBS的人是参与者之一。

sentences.en: But the administration ignored it all.
sentences.zh: 但政府对此置之不理。

sentences.en: And I'm not going to tell a country that's spending hundreds of billions of dollars and has helped me do one thing very importantly,
sentences.zh: 我不会去对一个花费数千亿美元、并在帮助我做一件非常重要的事情的国家说三道四，

sentences.en: keep oil prices down so that they're not going to $100 and $150 a barrel.
sentences.zh: 那就是压低油价，使其不会飙升到每桶100美元和150美元。

sentences.en: Right now, we have oil prices in great shape.
sentences.zh: 目前，我们的油价状况极佳。

sentences.en: I'm not going to destroy the world economy, and I'm not going to destroy the economy for our country by being foolish with Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 我不会因为对沙特阿拉伯愚蠢行事而毁了世界经济，也不会毁了我们国家的经济。

sentences.en: So I think this statement...
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这个声明……

sentences.en: So in some ways, this is a big challenge to MBS, but it's also something of a potential political gift to the administration because they can make the case to Congress and others
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，这对MBS是一个巨大的挑战，但对政府来说也算是一份潜在的政治礼物，因为他们可以向国会和其他人阐明理由

sentences.en: that while Saudi Arabia is no perfect government or society, that the Iranians are, in fact, more evil actors in the region.
sentences.zh: 尽管沙特阿拉伯并非完美的政府或社会，但伊朗实际上是该地区更具邪恶性质的行动者。

sentences.en: And that's essentially the argument they've been making in the past 48 hours.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是他们过去48小时一直在阐述的论点。

sentences.en: So this attack would potentially have the impact of drawing the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，这次袭击可能会产生这样的影响：将美国

sentences.en: and Saudi Arabia closer and giving the Trump administration a rationale for being closer to Mohammed bin Salman's Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 和沙特阿拉伯拉得更近，并为特朗普政府亲近穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼的沙特阿拉伯提供一个理由。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But there's also the concern inside the Pentagon that you not let Mohammed bin Salman drag the United States into a new Mideast war.
sentences.zh: 但五角大楼内部也有一种担忧，即不能让穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼把美国拖入一场新的中东战争。

sentences.en: You know, it was only a week ago that people in the Pentagon and elsewhere in the administration were showing a big sigh of relief
sentences.zh: 你知道，就在一周前，五角大楼和政府其他部门的人还在大大松了一口气，

sentences.en: that John Bolton had gotten fired as national security advisor because their concern was that Bolton would lead the United States ultimately into a conflict with Iran.
sentences.zh: 因为约翰·博尔顿被解除了国家安全顾问的职务，因为他们担心博尔顿最终会把美国带入与伊朗的冲突中。

sentences.en: Now, with Bolton gone, a series of unpredicted events may, in fact, push the U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在博尔顿走了，一系列未曾预料的事件实际上可能会把美国

sentences.en: and Saudi Arabia there or push the United States to back up the Saudis if the Saudis strike Iran.
sentences.zh: 和沙特阿拉伯推向那里，或者如果沙特打击伊朗，就会迫使美国支持沙特。

sentences.en: So just to review, Pompeo has said it's Iran.
sentences.zh: 所以回顾一下，蓬佩奥说这就是伊朗干的。

sentences.en: The president has said we're locked and loaded but going to let our ally Saudi Arabia lead the way in determining who it is.
sentences.zh: 总统说我们已经箭在弦上，但将让我们的盟友沙特阿拉伯在确定凶手是谁方面带头。

sentences.en: The Houthis are claiming credit.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装声称对此负责。

sentences.en: But why would the Houthis claim to have done this, carried out this audacious, sophisticated attack, if they hadn't?
sentences.zh: 但如果不是胡塞武装干的，他们为什么要声称自己实施了这次大胆、复杂的袭击？

sentences.en: Well, it's a great question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: I'm a bit confounded myself.
sentences.zh: 我自己也有点糊涂了。

sentences.en: The Houthis, of course, are backed by the Iranians.
sentences.zh: 当然，胡塞武装得到了伊朗的支持。

sentences.en: So it's conceivable the Iranians asked them to do it.
sentences.zh: 所以伊朗人要求他们这么做是合乎情理的。

sentences.en: It's conceivable that they just thought that by taking credit for it, they would look more powerful than they really are.
sentences.zh: 他们可能只是认为，通过认领这次袭击，他们会显得比实际更有力量。

sentences.en: And maybe in some way they were involved.
sentences.zh: 也许他们在某种程度上确实参与其中。

sentences.en: But the most important element of this is that the Saudis came out on Monday.
sentences.zh: 但其中最重要的一点是，沙特人在周一站出来了。

sentences.en: The Saudis specifically are pointing their finger at Iran, with whom, of course, they're involved in this proxy war.
sentences.zh: 沙特人明确将矛头指向了伊朗，而他们当然正与伊朗陷入这场代理人战争。

sentences.en: And declared that their examination of the evidence was that this attack was launched by Iran.
sentences.zh: 并宣称他们对证据的审查表明这次袭击是由伊朗发动的。

sentences.en: Specifically right now, however, while saying that these were Iranian weapon systems, they are saying they are still investigating precisely where those weapons were fired from.
sentences.zh: 不过目前具体而言，在宣称这些是伊朗武器系统的同时，他们表示仍在调查这些武器到底是从哪里发射的。

sentences.en: They have, however, ruled out Yemen as being that base.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们已经排除了也门作为该基地的可能。

sentences.en: They provided no evidence.
sentences.zh: 他们没有提供任何证据。

sentences.en: And that evidence may not exiSt.
sentences.zh: 而且这些证据可能根本不存在。

sentences.en: Because despite what you see in the movies, we don't have all-seeing eyes in the sky on all corners of the world at all times.
sentences.zh: 因为尽管你在电影里看到的那样，我们在世界各个角落的太空中并没有全知全能的眼睛时刻注视着一切。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《泰晤士报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《泰晤士报》一个月，甚至不需要输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《泰晤士报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载《泰晤士报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: David, if it turns out that this was Iran,
sentences.zh: 大卫，如果事实证明这就是伊朗干的，

sentences.en: why would Iran want to attack Saudi Arabia's oil facilities?
sentences.zh: 为什么伊朗要袭击沙特阿拉伯的石油设施？

sentences.en: What's the point of this kind of attack?
sentences.zh: 这种袭击的意义何在？

sentences.en: Well, one reason, Michael, is that the Iranians, of course, have been under sanction for more than a year now since the president left the Iranian nuclear agreement.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，原因之一是，自从总统退出伊朗核协议以来，伊朗人当然已经遭受了一年多的制裁。

sentences.en: So the Iranians may well want to send a message that says, you want to stop our oil shipments?
sentences.zh: 因此，伊朗人很可能想发出这样一个信息：你们想阻止我们的石油运输吗？

sentences.en: Well, we can stop yours.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们也可以阻止你们的。

sentences.en: And the message they're sending by having such a successful attack is, if you counter-strike against Iran or Iranian interests,
sentences.zh: 通过发动这样一次成功的袭击，他们传达的信息是：如果你对伊朗或伊朗利益进行反击，

sentences.en: you might see the rest of the oil fields go up in flames.
sentences.zh: 你可能会看到其余的油田陷入火海。

sentences.en: And take a look at what that will do to world oil markets and to the American economy.
sentences.zh: 看看这会对世界石油市场和美国经济产生什么影响。

sentences.en: And if you're trying to send a message to a president who is desperate to keep the American economy afloat, that's a pretty powerful message.
sentences.zh: 如果你试图向一个拼命维持美国经济运转的总统传递信息，那这是一个相当有力的信息。

sentences.en: The second thing is, it's not the first time we've seen the Iranians strike the Saudis as America's great ally, partner, and in the minds of the Iranians, their proxy.
sentences.zh: 第二件事是，这不是我们第一次看到伊朗人袭击沙特，将其作为美国的伟大盟友、伙伴，在伊朗人看来，也是美国的代理人。

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: authorities believe Iranian hackers are responsible for recent cyber attacks against major oil and gas companies in Saudi Arabia and Qatar.
sentences.zh: 当局认为，伊朗黑客是近期针对沙特阿拉伯和卡塔尔主要石油和天然气公司网络袭击的幕后黑手。

sentences.en: A virus known as Shamoon struck 30,000 computers and wiped out files and replaced them with an icon of a burning American flag.
sentences.zh: 一种名为沙蒙（Shamoon）的病毒袭击了3万台电脑，删除了文件，并用一个燃烧的美国国旗图标取而代之。

sentences.en: So either way, you slice it, this would be Iran seeking to hurt the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以无论你怎么看，这都是伊朗试图通过首先伤害沙特阿拉伯来伤害美国。

sentences.en: by first hurting Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 现在，伊朗人对此予以否认。

sentences.en: Now, the Iranians deny this.
sentences.zh: 伊朗外长

sentences.en: And the Iranian foreign minister,
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德·贾瓦德·扎里夫也发表了自己的推文，称美国在指责伊朗时，已经从极限施压转向了极限欺骗。
zh_words: 穆罕默德·贾瓦德·扎里夫

sentences.en: Mohammed Javad Zarif, turned out a tweet of his own saying that the United States in accusing Iran has moved from maximum pressure to maximum deceit.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德·贾瓦德·扎里夫也发了一条推文，称美国在指责伊朗时，已经从“极限施压”变成了“极限欺骗”。
zh_words: 穆罕默德·贾瓦德·扎里夫

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: and its clients are stuck in Yemen because of the illusion that weapon superiority will lead to military victory.
sentences.zh: 及其盟友被困在也门，是因为抱有一种幻觉，认为武器优势会带来军事胜利。

sentences.en: Blaming Iran won't end disaster.
sentences.zh: 指责伊朗并不能结束这场灾难。

sentences.en: They maintain they had nothing to do with it.
sentences.zh: 他们坚称自己与此毫无关系。

sentences.en: And that raises another question, which is, could the Iranian military have decided on its own to do this in order to prevent the president of Iran from meeting President Trump?
sentences.zh: 这就引发了另一个问题，那就是，伊朗军方会不会是擅自采取了这一行动，以此来阻止伊朗总统与特朗普总统会面？

sentences.en: Of course, President Trump had expressed an openness to meeting President Rouhani in New York.
sentences.zh: 当然，特朗普总统曾表示愿意在纽约会见鲁哈尼总统。

sentences.en: If the circumstances were correct or the right, I would certainly agree to that.
sentences.zh: 如果时机合适或者条件成熟，我当然会同意这一点。

sentences.en: But in the meantime,
sentences.zh: 但在此期间，

sentences.en: they have to be good players.
sentences.zh: 他们必须表现良好。

sentences.en: You understand what that means?
sentences.zh: 你明白那是什么意思吗？

sentences.en: You're suggesting an option where the Iranian military
sentences.zh: 你是说存在这样一种可能，即伊朗军方

sentences.en: sabotages any kind of conversation between their president and ours.
sentences.zh: 蓄意破坏他们总统与我们总统之间的任何对话。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: It's a live option.
sentences.zh: 这是一个现实的选项。

sentences.en: We don't have any evidence of it yet.
sentences.zh: 我们目前还没有任何证据。

sentences.en: But David, why would they do that?
sentences.zh: 但大卫，他们为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: Well, just as President Trump's decision to get out of the Iran nuclear agreement was highly controversial in the United States, the decision to enter the agreement in 2015
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如特朗普总统决定退出伊朗核协议在美国引发巨大争议一样，2015年加入该协议的决定

sentences.en: was highly controversial inside Iran.
sentences.zh: 在伊朗国内也引发了巨大争议。

sentences.en: And the Iranian military maintained that the civilian leadership and the Ayatollahs gave up too much.
sentences.zh: 伊朗军方坚称，文职领导层和阿亚图拉们让步太多。

sentences.en: And, of course, they had to shut down vast parts of their nuclear program, which was run by the Iranian military.
sentences.zh: 而且，他们当然不得不关闭了由伊朗军方运营的核计划的大部分内容。

sentences.en: So there are factions within the military that have made it very clear that they would like to see that entire agreement completely dissolved and Iran walk away
sentences.zh: 因此，军方内部的一些派别明确表示，他们希望看到整个协议彻底废除，伊朗退出

sentences.en: from all of the restrictions on it so they can have their nuclear program back.
sentences.zh: 所有限制，这样他们就能重新恢复核计划。

sentences.en: They're arguing, look, this has been a failure just like we said.
sentences.zh: 他们辩称，看吧，正如我们所说，这已经失败了。

sentences.en: The Americans didn't follow through on their own commitments.
sentences.zh: 美国人没有兑现他们自己的承诺。

sentences.en: They reimposed sanctions on us.
sentences.zh: 他们重新对我们实施了制裁。

sentences.en: It's hurting our economy.
sentences.zh: 这正在损害我们的经济。

sentences.en: And if it's going to hurt our economy, we're going to make sure it hurts the Saudis too.
sentences.zh: 既然这会损害我们的经济，我们也要确保它同样损害沙特人。

sentences.en: And is it to be expected that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，人们是否会预料到美国

sentences.en: would launch a military response to an attack like this on an ally like Saudi Arabia?
sentences.zh: 会对针对沙特阿拉伯这样的盟友的此类袭击作出军事回应？

sentences.en: Is that sort of a foregone conclusion or not necessarily?
sentences.zh: 这算是一种既成事实，还是未必如此？

sentences.en: It's not a foregone conclusion.
sentences.zh: 这并非既成事实。

sentences.en: You'll remember it was just a few months ago that the Iranians shot down a drone, an American drone, and the president decided not to go respond.
sentences.zh: 大家可能还记得，就在几个月前，伊朗击落了一架无人机，一架美国无人机，而总统决定不予回应。

sentences.en: In fact, the first response here may be that it's up to the Saudis to defend their own territory and to respond.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这里的首要反应可能是，保卫自己的领土并发起反击是沙特自己的事。

sentences.en: But of course, if the Saudis defended their own territory and the Iranians came back and tried to wipe out more Saudi oil fields, the United States would get sucked into that war.
sentences.zh: 但当然，如果沙特保卫了自己的领土，而伊朗卷土重来，试图消灭更多的沙特油田，美国就会被卷入这场战争。

sentences.en: And so, you want to make sure that the Iranians don't have a way to strike back if you strike them.
sentences.zh: 因此，你必须确保在打击伊朗人时，他们没有还手之力。

sentences.en: Otherwise, you're in an uncontrolled conflict.
sentences.zh: 否则，你就会陷入失控的冲突中。

sentences.en: And does the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么美国

sentences.en: have such strategies that would maintain dominance without provoking an inevitable response from Iran?
sentences.zh: 是否有这样的策略，能够在保持主导地位的同时，又不会激起伊朗不可避免的回应？

sentences.en: Well, we're about to find out,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们马上就要知道了，

sentences.en: Michael, I think.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我认为是这样的。

sentences.en: There are other more subtle things you could do.
sentences.zh: 你可以采取其他更微妙的手段。

sentences.en: You could gather the allies, show them the evidence of this strike, and do some more general sanctions on Iran.
sentences.zh: 你可以召集盟友，向他们展示这次袭击的证据，并对伊朗实施更广泛的制裁。

sentences.en: There are cyber options against Iran.
sentences.zh: 针对伊朗还有网络选项。

sentences.en: And in fact, the United States has a very complex cyber attack plan against Iran that details of which leaked out a few years ago and it would call for basically turning off
sentences.zh: 事实上，美国针对伊朗制定了一项非常复杂的网络攻击计划，其细节几年前泄露了，该计划基本上要求切断

sentences.en: much of the electric power in Iran.
sentences.zh: 伊朗的大部分电力供应。

sentences.en: So there are all kinds of ways that one could get back, but you want to be very careful with this because starting a war with Iran would be a pretty serious and fearsome thing.
sentences.zh: 所以反击的方式有很多种，但对此必须非常谨慎，因为与伊朗开战将是一件相当严重且可怕的事情。

sentences.en: And one thing we've learned about Donald Trump is he has backed away at moments when he has feared getting into a more general war, including the strike that he nearly
sentences.zh: 关于唐纳德·特朗普，我们了解到的有一点是，每当他害怕卷入更广泛的战争时，他就会退缩，包括上次我们失去那架无人机后，他几乎

sentences.en: went ahead with against Iranian facilities after we lost that drone.
sentences.zh: 准备对伊朗设施发动袭击的那一次。

sentences.en: David, you said earlier that the decision about how to proceed may actually rest with the Saudis.
sentences.zh: 大卫，你刚才说如何行事的决定实际上可能取决于沙特。

sentences.en: So what's your understanding of what they want in this moment?
sentences.zh: 那么，在你看来，他们此刻的需求是什么？

sentences.en: Well, the Saudis turned out a statement on Monday which basically was looking for international support.
sentences.zh: 嗯，沙特在周一发表了一份声明，基本上是在寻求国际支持。

sentences.en: They made the case that the target here were international and global energy supplies.
sentences.zh: 他们提出，此次袭击的目标是国际和全球能源供应。

sentences.en: In other words, they said they weren't the target, global energy supplies for the target.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他们声称自己不是目标，全球能源供应才是目标。

sentences.en: And there's a key line where it says the kingdom calls upon the international community to assume its responsibility in condemning those who stand behind this act and to take
sentences.zh: 其中有一句关键的话：王国呼吁国际社会承担起责任，谴责这一行为的幕后黑手，并采取

sentences.en: a firm and clear position against this reckless behavior that threatens the global economy.
sentences.zh: 坚定而明确的立场，反对这种威胁全球经济的鲁莽行径。

sentences.en: And then they invited in UN and international experts to look at the situation, participate in the investigation.
sentences.zh: 随后，他们邀请了联合国和国际专家来视察情况并参与调查。

sentences.en: So it sounds to me like they're not urging an immediate response but are trying to see if this is a moment to build some international consensus about Iran.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，他们似乎并不是在敦促立即作出回应，而是在试探这是否是建立关于伊朗的国际共识的时机。

sentences.en: David, I wonder what you think that this moment tells us.
sentences.zh: 大卫，我想知道你认为这个时刻说明了什么。

sentences.en: Well, it tells you how much disarray we're in.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这说明我们陷入了多么混乱的境地。

sentences.en: You know, it was only 2015, four years ago, that President Obama reached the nuclear deal with Iran.
sentences.zh: 要知道，就在2015年，也就是四年前，奥巴马总统才与伊朗达成了伊核协议。

sentences.en: And there was a brief few months where there was some optimism that if the U.S.
sentences.zh: 曾有短短几个月的时间，人们产生了一种乐观情绪，即如果美国

sentences.en: and Iran could put the nuclear disagreement behind them, it might be the opening to further cooperation or at least the end of more than three decades of constant hostility.
sentences.zh: 和伊朗能够将核分歧抛在脑后，这或许会成为进一步合作的契机，或者至少能结束长达三十多年的持续敌对状态。

sentences.en: And that's not what happened.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: And while there was a brief effort in the past few weeks by President Trump to show that he was willing to sit down and talk with the Iranians, that now seems off the table,
sentences.zh: 尽管在过去几周里，特朗普总统曾短暂努力展现自己愿意坐下来与伊朗人谈谈的姿态，但这现在似乎已经不可能了，

sentences.en: at least for some time.
sentences.zh: 至少在一段时间内是这样。

sentences.en: And there's every possibility that the response to this strike in Saudi Arabia or another strike by the Iranians or others in the region could actually trigger a regional war.
sentences.zh: 完全有可能的是，对这次沙特袭击的回应，或是伊朗或地区内其他势力发动的另一次袭击，实际上会引发一场地区战争。

sentences.en: And that's exactly what everybody's been trying to avoid for years now.
sentences.zh: 而这正是多年来大家一直试图避免的事情。

sentences.en: David,
sentences.zh: 大卫，

sentences.en: I'm curious if, reading between the lines, you're saying that if the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，字里行间的意思是否是说，如果美国

sentences.en: hadn't left the Iranian nuclear deal, that we might not be here right now.
sentences.zh: 当初没有退出伊核协议，我们今天就不会落得这般田地。

sentences.en: That's one of the great what-ifs of history.
sentences.zh: 这是历史上的重大“如果”之一。

sentences.en: The people who supported the president's decision made the point that the Iranians didn't decrease their bad behavior after they signed the deal in 2015.
sentences.zh: 支持总统决定的人指出，伊朗在2015年签署协议后并没有减少其恶劣行径。

sentences.en: They increased it.
sentences.zh: 他们反而变本加厉。

sentences.en: They supported the dictator in Syria,
sentences.zh: 他们支持叙利亚的独裁者，

sentences.en: Bashar Assad.
sentences.zh: 巴沙尔·阿萨德。

sentences.en: They continued support for terrorists.
sentences.zh: 他们继续支持恐怖分子。

sentences.en: And that, therefore, this was going to happen anyway.
sentences.zh: 因此，这一切迟早都会发生。

sentences.en: The proponents of the deal would say that by reimposing sanctions on Iran, we baited them and forced them to strike out.
sentences.zh: 而该协议的支持者会说，正是因为我们重新对伊朗实施制裁，才激怒并迫使其发动了反击。

sentences.en: And I think people will be arguing for years whether the decision to leave the Iranian deal was the trigger for this kind of event or whether it would have happened anyway.
sentences.zh: 我想人们将会争论多年，究竟是退出伊核协议的决定引发了此类事件，还是无论如何它都会发生。

sentences.en: David, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 大卫，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Monday afternoon at the White House,
sentences.zh: 周一下午在白宫，

sentences.en: President Trump struck a far less combative tone than he had over the weekend, saying he wanted to avoid conflict with Iran and saying he had not promised military protection
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统的语气远不如周末时那么好战，他表示希望避免与伊朗发生冲突，并称自己并未向沙特阿拉伯

sentences.en: to Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 承诺提供军事保护。

sentences.en: I haven't promised the Saudis that we have to sit down with the Saudis and work something out.
sentences.zh: 我没有向沙特承诺过，我们必须与沙特坐下来商讨解决办法。

sentences.en: And the Saudis want very much for us to protect them, but I say, well, we have to work.
sentences.zh: 沙特非常希望我们保护他们，但我说，好吧，我们得努力。

sentences.en: That was an attack on Saudi Arabia
sentences.zh: 那是针对沙特阿拉伯的袭击，

sentences.en: and that wasn't an attack on us.
sentences.zh: 那不是针对我们的袭击。

sentences.en: But the president emphasized that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但总统强调，如有必要，美国

sentences.en: was ready for military conflict with Iran, if necessary.
sentences.zh: 已准备好与伊朗发生军事冲突。

sentences.en: The United States is more prepared than any country in the history of, in any history, if we have to go that way.
sentences.zh: 如果非要走到那一步，美国比历史上的任何国家都要更有准备。

sentences.en: As to whether or not we go that way, we'll see.
sentences.zh: 至于我们是否会走到那一步，我们拭目以待。

sentences.en: We'll have to find out definitively who did it.
sentences.zh: 我们必须确切查明是谁干的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Monday, nearly 50,000 factory workers at General Motors walked off the job at plants across the country in their first nationwide strike since 2007.
sentences.zh: 周一，通用汽车公司全国各地的工厂近5万名工厂工人罢工，这是自2007年以来的首次全国性大罢工。

sentences.en: We stand strong in saying with one voice, we are standing up for our members and for the fundamental rights of working class people in this nation.
sentences.zh: 我们立场坚定，众口一词：我们要挺身而出，捍卫我们的会员以及这个国家工人阶级的基本权利。

sentences.en: The strike began after negotiators for GM and the United
sentences.zh: 此前，通用汽车和全美

sentences.en: Auto Workers Union failed to reach an agreement over wages, health care, and job security.
sentences.zh: 汽车工人联合会的谈判代表未能就工资、医疗保健和工作岗位安全达成协议，随后罢工爆发。

sentences.en: We're not asking for a whole lot.
sentences.zh: 我们并没有要求太多。

sentences.en: You know, we have a lot of young families in there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们的工会里有很多年轻家庭。

sentences.en: We have temporary workers.
sentences.zh: 我们有临时工。

sentences.en: They don't know from day to day, week to week, whether they'll have a job.
sentences.zh: 他们今天不知道明天，这周不知道下周，自己还有没有工作。

sentences.en: And that's no way to live.
sentences.zh: 这种日子根本没法过。

sentences.en: The strike highlights major changes underway in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这场罢工突显了美国

sentences.en: auto industry, including a shift away from sales of sedans to SUVs and pickup trucks, which has prompted
sentences.zh: 汽车行业正在经历的重大变革，包括从轿车销售转向SUV和皮卡，这促使

sentences.en: GM to close factories and seek greater flexibility from its workers and for GM's workers to demand higher pay and job security.

sentences.en: will hold its second election for Prime Minister in five months today after the previous election ended without a viable governing coalition.
sentences.zh: 今天将在五个月内举行第二次总理选举，此前上一届选举未能产生一个可行的执政联盟。

sentences.en: Polls show a close race between the same leading candidates as last time.
sentences.zh: 民调显示，与上次相同的几位主要候选人之间的竞争异常激烈。

sentences.en: Prime Minister
sentences.zh: 现任总理

sentences.en: Benjamin Netanyahu, a right-wing figure who faces possible indictment over corruption charges, and Benny Gantz, a former military chief who has run as a more moderate voice.
sentences.zh: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡是一位右翼政客，正面临因腐败指控而被起诉的可能；而本尼·甘茨则是一位前军事主官，以更为温和的立场参选。

sentences.en: The Times reports that another inconclusive outcome remains possible, with some Israeli leaders already predicting a third election.
sentences.zh: 据《泰晤士报》报道，选举结果难分胜负的情况仍可能再次出现，一些以色列领导人已经开始预测将举行第三次选举。
